Backend Engineer | Java, REST APIs & Event-Driven Services
Lisbon, Portugal | daniel.okafor-reyes@example.com | +351 555 010 202 | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/daniel-okafor-reyes-example

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Backend engineer with 7 years of experience designing and running Java/Spring Boot services for insurance and travel products. Experienced with relational databases, REST APIs, Kafka event-driven integration, automated testing, and deploying services to AWS Kubernetes. Production-focused engineer with a track record of improving API performance and reliability.

EXPERIENCE
Backend Engineer, Tejo Insurance Tech | Lisbon | Jan 2022–Present
• Develop and maintain 7 Java 17 Spring Boot microservices for policy quoting and claims intake.
• Designed the versioned REST API for partner quoting integration used by 12 broker partners, documented with OpenAPI.
• Consume and produce Kafka events for the claims workflow; introduced idempotent consumers and an outbox table, removing duplicate claim records.
• Reduced p99 quote endpoint latency from 1.8 seconds to 450 milliseconds by adding Redis caching and fixing JPA N+1 queries.
• Deploy services to Kubernetes (AWS EKS) using Helm charts and Jenkins pipelines; participate in on-call one week per month.

Software Developer, Viajar Online S.A. | Porto | Sep 2019–Dec 2021
• Built booking and payment features in a Java 11/Spring MVC monolith backed by Oracle.
• Wrote integration tests with Testcontainers, raising payments-module test coverage from 35% to 70%.
• Helped split the monolith by extracting the notifications service using Spring Boot and RabbitMQ.

Junior Developer (internship then full-time), CodeFarol Lda | Porto | Jul 2018–Aug 2019
• Performed PHP and later Java maintenance work for small business clients.

EDUCATION
BSc Informatics Engineering, Atlantic Polytechnic Institute | 2018

TECHNICAL SKILLS
Backend: Java (8–17), Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Data JPA, Hibernate, Kotlin (basic)
APIs and messaging: REST, OpenAPI, Kafka, RabbitMQ
Databases and caching: PostgreSQL, Oracle, Redis
Cloud and delivery: AWS (EKS, S3, SQS), Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, Jenkins
Testing and tools: JUnit 5, Testcontainers, Git, Linux

LANGUAGES
English (fluent), Portuguese (fluent), Spanish (conversational)
docs.cover_letter:
Daniel Okafor-Reyes
Lisbon, Portugal
daniel.okafor-reyes@example.com | +351 555 010 202 | linkedin.com/in/daniel-okafor-reyes-example

Dear Hiring Manager,

I am applying for the Backend Engineer role on Tessel Cargo Software’s Routing & Tracking team. Turning carrier events into a dependable live picture of shipments, while improving a customer-facing tracking API, is closely aligned with the production backend challenges I have worked on.

The role calls for Python or a comparable backend language; my seven years of production backend experience are in Java, primarily with Spring Boot. At Tejo Insurance Tech, I develop and maintain seven Java 17 microservices, designed a versioned REST API used by 12 broker partners, and improved a claims event workflow using Kafka, idempotent consumers, and an outbox table. I also reduced p99 quote endpoint latency from 1.8 seconds to 450 milliseconds by adding Redis caching and fixing JPA N+1 queries.

Earlier, at Viajar Online, I built booking and payment features, raised payments-module test coverage from 35% to 70% with Testcontainers integration tests, and helped extract a notifications service using Spring Boot and RabbitMQ. I also deploy services to AWS EKS with Helm and Jenkins and participate in an on-call rotation one week per month.

Tessel’s emphasis on dependable services, ownership of what the team runs, and dedicated reliability work resonates with my interest in clean APIs and production quality. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my experience in event-driven services, API performance, testing, and production operations could contribute to the Routing & Tracking team.

Sincerely,
Daniel Okafor-Reyes
